   1 At + Specific time                       At 6am, At 10'o' clock, At midnight, At noon, At night, At
                                              sunrise, At sunset, At dawn, At dusk.
   2 On + Day / Date                          On Monday, On Sunday, On 15th August, On 5th May.

   3 On + Specific Morning /                  On Monday morning, On Friday evening.
        Evening, etc.
   4 In + Month / Year / Season /             In January, In 2026, In winter, In the morning, In the
        Part of the day                       afternoon, In the evening, In the night.
   5 On + Festival / Special day              On Holi, On Diwali, On Christmas day, On Independence
                                              day, On birthday, On anniversary.

    Note
  We do not use any preposition before today, tomorrow, yesterday, tonight, next week, next
  month, next year, last night, last month, this morning, this week, this year, this Sunday, last
  Sunday, last Monday, every Sunday, next Monday etc.
